findings: All access, directory preparation and profile record writes finish within about 5ms in standalone rounds.

Standalone 3 simultaneous native opens take 1.62s cold and .94-1.03s warm; serial native opens take .54-.66s each, with three-source ready total 1.77/1.91s. This is controlled native serialization in current logical-admission code, not original global-create-chain transport.

In integrated cap2 warm, one native open takes3152ms: ready821ms and first paint927ms, document-load2935.7ms/root-load2936.1ms then worker enumeration215ms. Thus the extra2s is before native load completion, not samplePair/PNG.

Integrated cap2 clear-waveform terminal open has1591ms queue +1717ms native open, of which1110ms is recordWorkers. Waiting at2startslots introduces a new observed delay and does not remove the long native load.
Integrated cap3 warm2460ms/clear2541ms; cap2 warm3852ms/clear4216ms. These preliminary regenerated-ID runs reject shipping a fixed2slot queue on current evidence.

Earlier final media original-ID clear-waveform regression remains retained; startup-stage experiment did not instrument those original runs, so attributing their exact2s to the observed later cap2 load event still requires same-ID/request timing corroboration.
